items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I was very fortunate to meet peoples like Rudolph Valentino, Mr. Jack Dempsey

ctx.x: that when I was in Birmingham, Alabama, living in Esley Heights and I passed by a florist's by the name of Kelly Florists.. I knew a candlemaker by the name of Mr. Blackburn - that all these people had to do something with me making my life, because during that period I was very fortunate to meet peoples like Rudolph Valentino, Mr. Jack Dempsey, Judge Ebel Gary that Gary, Indiana, was named after him.
Was this when you were a kid?
